dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I've read that the heroes of legend would also put their feet up around bonfires!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: In some ways, that makes a little R-and-R part of the hero's journey too, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Hmm... and I don't hear anything dangerous nearby, so we can rest easy!
